anti_overfit_note: BRIEF 5.3: fixture zero (the EPYC 1P corpus) is ONE fixture among the cells, not the whole test - the anti-overfit rule stands. BRIEF 0.7: never prove the pipeline on one listing type (e.g. the parked EPYC lane); the engine must pass across ALL cells a-g below, which span Shopify retail JSON, configured servers, Reddit multi-item posts, liquidation/GovDeals lots, lot-vs-unit ambiguity, quarantine paths, and cost-basis records. Hardest shapes in one package: board+CPU+RAM combos, barebones, configurator base variants, sale-vs-list price, out-of-stock, title-vs-description conflicts.
